journey.name: usdt receive swipe tabs
journey.description:
On the Receive sheet, swiping sideways over the QR changes tabs on every tab, USDT included. With USDT selected, a swipe to the right over its QR selects the tab before it (Savings, since a wallet without a Lightning channel has no Spending tab) and does not copy the address; a swipe to the left wraps around to the first tab (Savings), since USDT is the last tab. A single tap on the USDT QR still copies the address and shows the "copied" tooltip.
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet with USDT enabled (introductory sheet or Settings, General, Payments) and no Lightning channel, so the tabs are Savings and USDT (Blocktank channel purchases were removed in synonymdev/bitkit-android#1669, and the Spending tab appears only over a channel with inbound liquidity). Start on the wallet home screen. The USDT address loads without funding; wait for the QR before swiping.
The copy shows as a tooltip over the QR for about two seconds, so a check for "no copy" reads a screenshot taken right after the swipe. Swipe with `adb shell input swipe` across the middle of the QR, about 60% of its width, in 300 ms. Back from Savings to USDT goes through the tab pager, which snaps back from a 300 ms synthetic swipe on the emulator; a 600 ms swipe moves it.

actions.action: Tap the USDT tab (testTag "Tab-usdt") and wait until the USDT QR is visible
Swipe right across the QR and take a screenshot right away
Verify the Savings tab (testTag "Tab-savings") is selected, there is no Spending tab (testTag "Tab-spending"), and the screenshot shows no "copied" tooltip
Swipe left across the middle of the Savings QR in 600 ms (`adb shell input swipe 900 1200 150 1200 600`); verify the USDT tab is selected and wait until its QR is visible
Tap the USDT QR once and verify the "copied" tooltip appears
Wait until the tooltip is gone, swipe left across the USDT QR and take a screenshot right away; verify the Savings tab (testTag "Tab-savings") is selected and the screenshot shows no "copied" tooltip
